description: Prepare a link to the free inquiry form, prefilled with a published institution (optionally its campus and service channel), city and an administrative topic. The link is for the user to open; the user writes the question, consents and verifies their email. This read-only tool does not submit an inquiry, send email, book, upload or pay, and accepts no personal details.
name: prepare_inquiry_link
title: Prepare a prefilled inquiry link
